memberdef.name: PRINTCOMP
memberdef.initializer: [](StringRef Name, const amd_kernel_code_t &C, raw_ostream &OS) { \ printName(OS, Name) << \ (int)GetMacro(C.compute_pgm_resource_registers >> Shift); \ }

memberdef.name: PARSECOMP
memberdef.initializer: [](amd_kernel_code_t &C, MCAsmParser &MCParser, raw_ostream &Err) { \ int64_t Value = 0; \ if (!expectAbsExpression(MCParser, Value, Err)) \ return false; \ C.compute_pgm_resource_registers &= ~(SetMacro(0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFULL) << Shift); \ C.compute_pgm_resource_registers |= SetMacro(Value) << Shift; \ return true; \ }
